This audiovisual collection brings together sound and visual recordings from the Voces de Mujeres project, produced between 2006 and 2010. The materials explore themes of gender, memory, and political participation in Central America: from an analysis of the tenth anniversary of the Guatemalan peace accords to debates on the historical role of women and the working conditions of migrant and indigenous women. The collection is held at the Human Rights Documentation Initiative (HRDI) of LLILAS Benson Latin American Studies and Collections, University of Texas at Austin, and is part of the archival work developed within the Digital Scholarship Research Fellowship (LLILAS Benson, 2024–2025).
